correctness.rationale: A pivot Jacobi step acts by a plane orthogonal matrix on each nonpivot pair (a_pk,a_qk). Both entries start <=s in magnitude; hence each new component <=sqrt(2)*s, the pivot is zero, and unaffected entries stay <=s. The explicit symmetric offdiagonal template (1,tau,-tau) has equal pivot diagonals and 45-degree rotation realizing sqrt(2)*tau. The eigenvalues 1 and (-1±sqrt(1+8tau²))/2, and c=(1-kappa*beta_minus)/(kappa-1), make the shift SPD of exactly condition number kappa. Check n=2 and tau=0 separately; strict spikes need tau>1/sqrt(2). This is a complete elementary proof, not an inference from the packaged numerical log.
